description: a tyrant of burning brass who rules a city of forges

description: A Large insectile horror. It has four scythe-arms, a spitting maw, and a shell that sheds acid. It fights by pinning prey with two arms and carving with the others.
canary: FEATURE — the exact case. Its Two-Arm Pin describes what happens WHILE a creature is grappled; the call reads that as `requires` and nothing may overwrite it with `imposes`.

description: a constrictor that crushes harder the longer it holds you
canary: FEATURE — a trait predicated on an existing grapple, escalating. Must record `requires`, not `imposes`.

description: a gaoler that cannot attack anyone it is not already holding
canary: FEATURE — a restriction predicated on a grapple. The condition is a precondition twice over.

description: a mire-thing whose victims sink deeper every round they stay restrained
canary: FEATURE — Restrained as a precondition, not Grappled; the fix must not be grapple-specific.

description: a dread-piper whose music only works on the already frightened
canary: FEATURE — Frightened as a precondition. Also crosses the payoff path.

description: a kiln-golem that seals a swallowed victim inside its furnace chest
canary: FEATURE — swallow/containment, where print DOES impose and DOES carry an escape DC. The fix must not suppress a real imposition.

description: a sentinel of black iron that pins one foe and ignores all others
